title: 采样算法 v2 + 空洞修补（3 轮密度感知排斥）

searched.takeaway: Good stipple: no clumps, no uneven voids. Unweighted Lloyd equalizes spacing and blurs the image. Density ρ must weight the centroid. This project is light-on-#050505 so ρ ∝ handbook w=0.6+0.4·L^1.2 (not Secord's 1−f ink density).

searched.q: Fast Poisson Disk Sampling in Arbitrary Dimensions Bridson 2007
searched.takeaway: Blue-noise / Poisson-disk: samples at least r apart. Clustering causes holes. Handbook lists Poisson as 进阶备选; this step uses the authorized 3-round 邻域排斥 with local r ∝ 1/√ρ.

searched.q: Lloyd relaxation blue noise stippling holes voids
searched.takeaway: Stop Lloyd early (3 rounds) to keep stardust; full convergence hex-chains. Fill remaining empty eligible cells by moving surplus from overcrowded cells.

red_lines: Sample once at preprocess, never per frame
